Author: TODO-author
Name: PartyMoogle
Punchline: Per-event push notifications to ntfy and Discord.
Description: Sends push notifications to ntfy and/or Discord for a wide range of FFXIV events — duty pops, party join/leave, chat (filterable by channel and keyword), duty lifecycle, level up, zone change and more. Every event is individually enable-able with its own channel routing, gated by a single 'only while away' toggle. Fork of PushyFinder (MIT).
